contexts.text: He perceives there is speculation within his forehead...
The spiritual angelic choir... distinguishes its pleasant speculations, and separates them into ideas...
The word speculation may serve to denote the more interior things; (and is thus intermediate in its meaning between imagination and thought).
So that there are a thousand things in a speculation of the more interior Angels which appear as simple to those of the interior Heaven.
This part of the memory... thus passes to speculation, and constitutes it. Explained. SE 3265.
I have been introduced into such respirations... by intense speculations, in which the respiration becomes quiescent. In no other way is an intense speculation of truth possible.
The continual thought and speculation of the Dutch about trade.
